21:83.text: Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."

21:84.text: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him
his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers

21:85.text: Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.

21:86.text: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.

and thought that We would not decree
And he called out within the darknesses,
"There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."

21:88.text: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

21:89.text: Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone
, while You are the best of inheritors."

21:90.text: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate
Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
